jeux.name: La salle de jeux · The games room
jeux.alt: The games room of the games house on games evening, seen from the near left and slightly above: a black-and-white checkerboard floor running away at an angle, white walls painted with big black dice dots, a red baseboard, shelves of board games and round hanging lamps. At the back a girl in a green dress kisses a four-leaf clover beside two big white dice on a little table, a grandpa in a brown cardigan sighs over a board game while his grandson in blue overalls cheers with both fists, and a man dressed as a czar in a fur-trimmed crown pulls a paper ticket out of a black top hat with his eyes shut. In the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret stands on a red-and-white ring buoy holding out a fan of playing cards, a second Monsieur Verbe beside a little potted tree puts a finger to his lips with a card hidden by his cuff, and a farmer in a red bandana pushes a waist-high wooden pawn across the floor. In front a lady with glasses and a gray bun frowns over her chessboard sipping lemonade through a bendy straw, and at a round green card table a man with a curly mustache presses down a card with a big red heart while a lady in a turquoise blouse with a golden-star card toots a little party horn. The checkerboard double doors in the left wall lead out to the boulevard, the narrow purple door in the middle of the back wall goes to the lotto hall and the red double door at the right of the back wall opens into the party room.

doors.label: Le loto
doors.hint: the narrow purple door in the middle of the back wall, to the lotto hall

doors.label: L'anniversaire
doors.hint: the red double door on the back wall at right, to the party room

loto.name: La soirée loto · Lotto night
loto.alt: The lotto night hall of the games house seen from the near left and slightly above: purple walls with small gold dots, a low wooden stage with a purple front along the back wall, flat white ceiling lights and a pale plank floor running away at an angle. Up on the stage a lady in a purple dress turns the handle of a big wire lottery drum full of colored balls with a hamster riding on top, and Monsieur Verbe in a red beret digs a wooden game tile out of a heap with a toy pickax. At the back right two men in flat caps shake hands on a bet across a little table with a model Eiffel Tower, and in the corner a grandma in a pink cardigan dances on tiptoe holding up a bingo card of colored squares. On the left a lady with red curls in a gold dress hugs a sack spilling gold coins, humming with music notes floating up. In the middle a beekeeper in a white suit kneels turning the dial of a small black safe with a big fuzzy bee on top while her little son cheers, and a kneeling boy watches a line of black dominoes topple, stopping just before a glass vase of flowers. In front a girl in a blue tracksuit rolls a wooden ball at a row of white skittles, one of them shaped like a giant golden key, and an old man in slippers lies back in a striped deckchair with a green pet lizard on his knee. The purple door with gold dots at the left end of the back wall leads back to the games room.

doors.label: Les jeux
doors.hint: the closed purple door with gold dots at the left end of the back wall, back to the games room

fete.name: La fête d'anniversaire · The birthday party
fete.alt: The party room of the games house during a child's birthday party, seen from the near left and slightly above: a pastel pink side wall meets a pastel mint back wall with a big painted rainbow, like two colors of icing, and white floorboards run away at an angle. At the back a tall red-haired girl in green on a stepladder holds up a string of red paper hearts, a white-haired grandma stirs a big glass bowl of pink punch with a giant wooden spoon, and three children wearing crowns of ivy leaves dance a conga line. At the long table with the white cloth little blond Annie blows out the five candles on her birthday cake while her uncle in a green shirt reads aloud from a blank sheet, and on the right a lady designer in a teal dress and patterned scarf places a giant wooden apple-core sculpture on a white plinth. In the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret sits on a hay bale wrapping a big box in shiny blue paper. In front a girl in a pink dress on a stool opens a golden envelope with a gray pigeon at her feet, and a girl in a yellow dress throws confetti and shakes hands with a little birthday boy wearing a big rosette. The red double door in the pink wall leads back to the games room, the white door with the flower garland in the back wall goes to the wedding hall, and the yellow porthole door at the right end goes out to the carnival courtyard.

doors.label: Les jeux
doors.hint: the red double door in the pink left wall, back to the games room

doors.label: La noce
doors.hint: the white door with a flower garland in the back wall, to the wedding hall

doors.label: Le carnaval
doors.hint: the yellow porthole door at the right end of the back wall, out to the carnival courtyard

noce.name: La noce · The wedding party
noce.alt: The wedding reception hall of the games house at the moment the ceremony ends and the party begins, seen from the near left and above: ivory walls with gold trim, swags of white drapes with little bunches of white flowers, potted white roses and a pale herringbone parquet running away at an angle. At the back a lady officiant in a green robe rings a little silver bell at a flower-covered lectern, a guest dressed as a maharaja in a jeweled turban and gold coat throws red rose petals, the groom in a gray morning suit waves under the big white flower arch beside the tiered cake, and an old man in a tweed suit bows deeply before a portrait of a smiling white-haired grandmother on an easel. On the left a young woman in a pink gown proudly shows off her sparkly engagement ring to her friend in green, who clasps her hands dreamily. In the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret and little fairy wings cheers and waves a crescent-moon wand, and a nervous young man in a blue suit fans his face with a big paper fan. In front a little girl in a yellow dress leads a small white pony with a big yellow bow on its nose, and a waltzing couple in tails and a pale blue ball gown hold up a big striped beach ball. The white door with a flower garland at the left end of the back wall leads back to the birthday party room.

doors.label: L'anniversaire
doors.hint: the white door with a flower garland at the left end of the back wall, back to the birthday party

carnaval.name: Le carnaval · The carnival
carnaval.alt: The big cobbled courtyard behind the games house on carnival day, seen from the near left and slightly above: the black-and-white checkerboard wall of the games house on the left, a stone terrace with a balustrade and steps on the right, a tall striped carnival pole with ribbons and colorful bunting across a blue sky. Along the checkerboard wall at the back a lady in an orange dress cheers and claps two big white clam shells together like cymbals, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret dances a jig on an upturned wooden crate, a tall lady in a red polka-dot dress rides a unicycle juggling oranges, and a young man pulls a carnival float shaped like a smiling blue shark on a wooden cart. In the middle a bald grandpa with a white mustache in a purple cardigan waves happily with a bunch of colored balloons, and behind a bench shaped like a giant banana Monsieur Verbe holds his gloved hands up like kitten paws to make a giggling toddler laugh. On the right a woman in a big feathered pink carnival costume waves from a little open toy car. In front a marching chef in a white hat and red neckerchief heads the parade holding up a platter with a pink fish fillet, followed by a cheerful man in a padded yellow star costume shaking a maraca. The yellow porthole door in the checkerboard wall at the near left leads back to the birthday party.

doors.label: L'anniversaire
doors.hint: the yellow porthole door in the checkerboard wall at the near left, back to the birthday party
